graph_decision.evidence: J1 and J2 form a clear transient offset in all three axes: N shows a negative step at J1 followed by return near J2; E shows a positive step at J1 and return near J2; U shows a negative step at J1 and return near J2. The auxiliary plots confirm these are isolated spikes, not part of the slow trend. J3 is a permanent downward step in all axes (N, E, U) with no return—visible as a sustained level shift after J3 in both original and residual plots. P1 is the only valid pair; P2 and P3 incorrectly link J3 (permanent) to earlier transients. No shared endpoints among selected pair/step IDs.
